# Sam Walby

> Freelance writer, editor and interviewer based in Sheffield, South Yorkshire, UK.

Sam Walby is a writer, editor and interviewer based in Sheffield, South Yorkshire, with nearly 20 years of experience in independent magazine publishing, social enterprise and community initiatives. He was Editor-in-Chief of Now Then Magazine from 2009 to 2026.

## Services
- Writing & storytelling: working collaboratively with story sources and stakeholders on everything from Q&A transcripts and long-form articles to insight reports and reflections
- Editing & post-production: from helping to shape a story in its earliest version to fine-detail copy editing and pre-publication proofreading
- Interviews & facilitation: hosting generative, supportive conversations which plant the seeds for compelling written and audio stories
- Bid writing & project management: bringing together the needs of organisations and their stakeholders with grant funders' priorities to give the best chance of success, then ensuring the project is delivered well, in time and within budget

## Location
Sheffield, South Yorkshire, UK. Available for remote work worldwide.
